observation: Front, top and iso all show one coherent set with nothing missing, extra, floating or interpenetrating. Top: the 7x9 field is complete across four butted panels, all sixteen worlds stand in the mirrored opening setup on their own cells, twelve belt tiles fill the two 2x3 blocks either side of the middle, the three corona cells and the den sit at each end in that army's own colour, and the two trays stand clear of the board. Front: the size ladder is monotonic left to right across the row and every disc rests on the field with no piece leaning or sinking. Iso: the rank ladder, the two disc colours and the two flame colours all read, and Neptune's white cloud marks are visible on both pieces as short separate marks rather than as rings round the ball. No part crosses another anywhere in the three views.
